svg.title: About Joe Ward: Full Stack Flutter Developer
svg.text: I'm a Full Stack Flutter Developer with a passion for creating beautiful, functional, and
user-centered digital experiences. With expertise spanning mobile development, web
technologies, and AI integration, I bring ideas to life through code.
My journey started in 2022 when I began my Bachelor's degree, then dove into
programming fundamentals in 2023. By 2024, I found my calling in Flutter
development, and since then I've been continuously expanding my skills from state
Today, I specialize in building production-ready Flutter apps with clean architecture,
comprehensive testing, and smooth animations. I'm always exploring new technologies
